# Satori neuron (browser app)

> The Satori neuron as a client-side web app. It registers with Satori's
> central server, polls central for the latest observation of each data
> stream, forecasts the next values with a simple model, and sends the
> predictions back to central, the way the Docker neuron (Satori Lite) does.
> It also follows Satori streams on Nostr relays and publishes a prediction
> stream (`<stream>_pred`) for each one it subscribes to, and predicts on
> Base: the vault delegates its prediction power to the identity, which sends
> one batch of up/down predictions every UTC round on its own.
> Everything runs in the browser tab: the keys, the database (DuckDB-WASM on
> OPFS) and the engine. There is no server of our own. It is built to be
> driven by people and by AI agents alike.

Status: steps 1–6 of the roadmap are built (two keys, central's data flow,
the engine, Nostr, Base), and a finishing pass is done (2026-10-15).

## Quick start (an agent)

In the page's JS context (Playwright's `page.evaluate`, a browser console):

1. Wait until `document.body.dataset.screen` is not `loading` (DuckDB-WASM
   and the keys take a few seconds; it is kept current: `setup`, `home`,
   `elsewhere`, `fatal`). Then `window.satori` is ready.
2. On `setup`: `await satori.setup({ passphrase: 'at least 4 chars' })` → the
   status, `screen: 'home'`. The neuron now runs on its own.
3. `await satori.poll()`: central's observations in, predictions out.
4. `await satori.discover()`, then `await satori.subscribe(pubkey, stream_name)`
   for a free stream: each observation is forecast and published as
   `<stream>_pred`.
5. Base: fund both Base addresses (on the dev server's local fork:
   `node scripts/fork.mjs fund <identity 0x…>` and
   `node scripts/fork.mjs fund <vault 0x…> --satori 100`), then
   `await satori.unlock(passphrase)`, `await satori.delegate()`,
   `await satori.predictBase()`.

Every method is below; `await satori.status()` shows everything at once.

## Concepts

- Identity key: the neuron's own key (Evrmore address, "E…"). Stored
  unencrypted in this browser (Docker's `wallet.yaml`) so the neuron runs from
  page load with nobody present. It signs central's login challenge.
- Vault key: holds funds. Stored encrypted with the passphrase (Docker's
  `vault.yaml`). **Unlock** (enter the passphrase) decrypts it into memory;
  **Lock** wipes it. The neuron does not need the vault to run; its public key
  is read from `vault.yaml` while locked.
- Central: `https://network.satorinet.io` in a build;
  `https://central2.satorinet.io` (the dev central) on the dev server.
  Changeable (https only).
- Register: on every page load, `POST /api/v1/peer/register` with the
  identity's and the vault's public keys. Central links the vault to the
  identity once; a different vault on central shows as a "vault mismatch".
- Poll: `GET /api/v1/observations/batch?limit=100`, the latest observation of
  each stream (under 48 h old). The first poll is 5–30 min after the page
  loads (random), then every 11 h; the next time is stored, so a reload keeps
  it. `satori.poll()` (or "Poll now") runs one at once.
- Stream: one of central's streams, by uuid, with its name. Observations are
  stored once per (stream, whole second).
- Prediction: made only for a stream that got a new observation, from all of
  its stored history. `t1` is 12 h ahead, `t2` 24 h ahead (the value central
  scores, against the first observation 24 h or more after it). Sent right
  after the poll in one batch (`POST /api/v1/predictions/batch`, after a
  login signed by the identity) as `{stream_uuid, stream_name, value: t2,
  t1_value: t1, observed_at, hash}`, with Python's float formatting. Status
  `pending` until central accepts the batch; a rejected or failed batch is
  resent with the next poll. Pending predictions older than 22 h (2 × 11 h)
  are dropped. Every call to central is resent once on a network error, a
  timeout or a 5xx.
- Model (the engine, `src/engine/`, docs/design/engine.md): after the owner's
  `namaste_club` engine. History is cut into 12 h UTC buckets (the last value
  in each) and turned into returns r = v_k / v_(k-1) - 1.
  - `bar1`: a Bayesian AR(1) on those returns, r_next = phi * r. phi is shrunk
    toward 0 ("tomorrow = today") with a N(0, 0.2^2) prior: phi = sum(x*y) /
    (sum(x*x) + sigma^2 / 0.2^2). Two 12 h steps give t1 and t2, each step's
    return clamped to +-50%. Then t = last * (1 + weight * (growth - 1)).
    `weight` in [0, 1] comes from a backtest on the stream's own buckets (of
    the last 28 origins, those with three back-to-back buckets):
    weight = clamp(2 - model error / persistence error, 0, 1), so a model that
    trails the last value is faded toward it (1 with fewer than 5 origins).
  - `naive`: t1 = t2 = the last value. Used until a stream has 6 lag pairs.
    A pair is three back-to-back 12 h buckets, each with an observation, so
    bar1 needs an observation every 12 h (about 4 days of polls every 11 h).
    A stream central updates once a day, or a neuron that polls once a day,
    stays naive: gaps are not bridged.
  - `bar1d`: the same model on changes (v_k − v_(k-1), additive steps
    clamped to the largest change seen, absolute backtest errors) for a
    series with any value ≤ 0, such as a named Base stream's signed counter.
  `phi` and `weight` are stored with each prediction (null for `naive`).
  `node scripts/backtest.mjs` measures it against persistence on real
  history: a tie on liquid crypto pairs.
- Changing the central URL drops the pending predictions, the stream list and
  the last poll/submission (another central has other stream uuids); the list
  refills with the next poll.

- Nostr key: a third key, random (not derived from the identity or the
  vault), stored unencrypted like the identity (Docker's `nostr.yaml`,
  `{pubkey_hex, secret_hex}`). It signs the neuron's Nostr events; its 64-hex
  pubkey is sent to central on register (`nostr-pubkey`).
- Relays: central's list (`GET /api/v1/peer/relays`, today
  `ws://satorian.satorinet.io:7777`) plus the user's (Settings or
  `setRelays`). On the dev server central's relays are read only (requests,
  never events) and the user's relays default to the test relay
  `ws://localhost:7778`; a build writes to central's relays too. An https page
  cannot open `ws://` relays (shown as blocked); it needs `wss://`.
- Network streams: the relays' catalog of stream announcements (kind 34600),
  newest per (provider pubkey, stream name), deleted ones dropped. A
  provider is a Nostr pubkey (64 hex). Prediction streams end in `_pred`.
- Subscribe: to a free, open stream (paid, encrypted or approval-gated ones
  come later), at most `maxStreams` at once: central's `max_streams` (60
  today), or Lite's own 100 when central has not answered. It publishes a
  subscription event (34602) and announces `<stream>_pred` (34600). The
  first observation that arrives is the relays' stored latest one (an
  observation is replaceable: a relay keeps one per stream), so it may be
  old; then each new one. Each new
  observation (34601) of the stream is stored, forecast two cadences ahead
  (t2 of the engine with the stream's `cadence_seconds` as its step, as Lite
  sends) and published as `<stream>_pred` with `value` = the forecast as a
  string (`"82378.0"`),
  `seq_num` = our last + 1. A value with no number is echoed. Relay streams
  and predictions are kept apart from central's and never sent to central.
  Unsubscribe publishes the unsubscription and deletes the `_pred`
  announcement (a tombstone).
- Hourly: the relay list again, dropped relays reconnected, `_pred`
  announcements again; daily: a NIP-65 relay list (10002).

- Base (Base Sepolia, chain 84532, the D6 contracts; docs/design/base.md):
  each key's 32-byte secret is also its EVM key, so the identity and the
  vault each have a Base (0x) address (the vault's is read from vault.yaml's
  public key while locked). Addresses: bundled, with central's
  `/api/v1/base/config` over them (cached 1 h; prod answers 404, central2
  serves it). RPC: Settings or `setBaseRpc`; empty = the default: on the dev
  server `/rpc`, a local anvil fork (`node scripts/fork.mjs start`); in a
  build central's (`https://sepolia.base.org`), then publicnode. An RPC on
  another chain than 84532 is refused (nothing is read or sent).
- Delegate prediction power (needs Unlock): the identity sets its predictor
  fee to 0 (`rewards.setPredictorFee(0)`, set-once) and accepts only this
  vault (`hub.setAllowedDelegator(vault)`), then the vault calls
  `hub.delegatePredictionPower(identity)`. Each step only when needed. While
  delegated the vault's SATORI is transfer-locked; Stop delegating
  (`delegatePredictionPower(0x0)`) leaves it locked through the next round:
  the token refuses transfers while `transferLockedUntil >= round`, so
  "until round N" means free from round N + 1 at 00:00 UTC. ("Staking" in the
  Docker neuron.)
- Prediction power: the vault's SATORI, delegated to the identity. A vault
  with no SATORI, or one that has not delegated, gives the identity none, and
  the batch skips (`no prediction power delegated to the identity`).
- The daily batch (the identity, no Unlock): once per UTC round
  (`block.timestamp / 86400`), at the first check of the round (10 s after
  load, after Delegate, at the round's start on the chain's clock, at least
  hourly), when the identity has delegated power and no batch this round.
  Every registry stream whose binary game has voting weight (the engine pays
  only those) is forecast by the engine (step = max(12 h, the stream's
  cadence); a named stream, a signed counter, as `bar1d`); direction UP
  (payload `0x01`) if t2 > the latest value, else DOWN (`0x02`), as the
  Docker neuron. Each game is simulated alone first (the contract's own
  checks, named games' 24 clock hours included) and only the ones that pass
  are sent, in one `engine.predictMultipleWithPayloads`, if the max fee per
  gas is within the ceiling (`setBaseMaxFee`, 2 gwei by default; above it the
  next check tries again). Its hash is kept at once, so a check never sends
  twice; the batch is stored after its receipt, its round from its block.
- Claims (needs Unlock), each on its own: `hub.claim()` when the rewards lens
  says > 0 (the vault's share of the identity's wins); the merkle drop
  (`GET /api/v1/merkle/proof/{vault}` on central, then `claimMerkle` when
  owed; the amount is what the reserve paid); the vested airdrop
  (`claimAirdrop`).
- Gas: both addresses need a little Base ETH (the identity for the batch,
  the vault for its actions). Every contract call is simulated first (a
  revert costs nothing and names the contract's error) and sent with 500,000
  gas over the estimate (unused gas is not charged); an ETH send uses its
  estimate. The tip is the node's `eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas`, the max fee
  2 × the base fee + the tip.

Times are unix seconds.

## Drive it from the page (window.satori)

Open the app and wait until `document.body.dataset.screen` is not `loading`
(synchronous, kept current; `await satori.status()` says the same). Then, in
the page's JS context:

- `await satori.status()` → `{ screen, identity, vault, unlocked, central, nostr, base }`.
  `screen` is `setup` (no keys yet), `home` (running), `elsewhere` (another
  tab has it open; only one tab runs the neuron) or `fatal`. `central` (on
  `home`) is `{ url, registration, lastPoll, nextPoll, polling, lastSubmit,
  pending }`:
  - `registration`: null while registering; then
    `{ at, ok: true, peer_id, wallet_address, vault_address, message, vaultMismatch }`
    or `{ at, ok: false, error }` (central refused or is unreachable).
  - `lastPoll`: `{ at, streams, new, predicted }` or `{ at, error }` (central's
    error, or a local one such as a database write).
  - `lastSubmit`: `{ at, total_submitted, successful, failed, errors }` or
    `{ at, error }`; `pending`: how many predictions wait to be sent.
- `await satori.setup({ passphrase, vaultWords?, identityWords? })` → status.
  Creates the neuron on a fresh browser (random keys unless 24 words are
  given). Passphrase: at least 4 characters, Latin-1 only (no emoji or €), as
  Docker's vault encryption needs. The vault starts locked. One setup runs at
  a time: a call while another (or the UI's) is running throws `Busy (setup)…`,
  and a call once set up throws `Already set up`.
- `await satori.poll()` → `{ poll, submit }`: poll central now, store, forecast
  the streams with a new row, and send everything pending. `submit` is null
  when nothing was pending or when the poll failed (`poll.error`). It never
  throws for central's errors. One poll runs at a time; a call during one
  returns it. The next poll is then 11 h later.
- `await satori.streams()` → one row per stream: `uuid`, `name`, `meta`
  (central's stream meta: the parsed object when it is JSON, else its text,
  or null), `observations`, `obs_ts`, `obs_value`, and our latest `t1`, `t2`,
  `model` (`bar1`, `bar1d` or `naive`), `phi`, `weight`, `made_at`, `status`
  (`pending`/`sent`), `sent_at`.
- `await satori.predictions(stream, limit = 20)` → one stream's predictions
  (by uuid or name), newest first: `[{ id, stream_uuid, name, made_at, model,
  t1, t2, phi, weight, observed_at, hash, status, sent_at }]`. `observed_at`
  and `hash` are what was sent: as in Lite, `observed_at` is the time the
  prediction was made (Python's float text of unix seconds), not the
  observation's time; `hash` = sha256(value + observed_at)[:16].
- `await satori.setCentral(url)` → `status().central`: an https URL, or `''`
  for the default; registers there at once. A different URL drops the pending
  predictions and the stream list (see Concepts).
- `await satori.unlock(passphrase)` → true (one at a time, as the UI's:
  another while one runs throws `Busy (unlock)…`); `satori.lock()` → true.
- While unlocked: `satori.backup('identity' | 'vault')` → `{ words, wif }`;
  `satori.file('wallet.yaml' | 'vault.yaml' | 'nostr.yaml')` → the Docker
  file's text. Only these exact names; anything else throws. These need
  Unlock as Docker's dashboard needs login, `wallet.yaml` and `nostr.yaml`
  too, although they are stored unencrypted: they are private keys.
- `await satori.nostr()` (also `status().nostr`) → `{ pubkey, npub,
  maxStreams, centralWrite, userRelays, relays, subscriptions }`. `relays`:
  `[{ url, from: ['central' | 'user'], write, state, error }]`, state
  `open` | `connecting` | `closed` (it retries) | `blocked`. `subscriptions`:
  `[{ uuid, stream, provider, name, cadence_seconds, subscribed_at,
  observations, observation: { seq, ts, value, raw, received_at } | null,
  prediction: { stream, seq, value, model, made_at, relays } | null }]`
  (`value` is the number taken from the observation or null; `raw` is what
  the provider sent; `prediction.relays` is how many relays took our latest
  `_pred`; `model` is `bar1`, `bar1d`, `naive` or `echo`). `maxStreams` is
  100 until central's relay config answers, then central's (60).
- `await satori.discover()` → the catalog: `[{ pubkey, stream_name, name,
  description, cadence_seconds, price_per_obs, encrypted, approval_required,
  tags, metadata, created_at, pred, subscribed, relays }]`, newest first;
  `relays` lists the relays that sent the announcement. Right after
  a load it waits up to 10 s for the relays still connecting, then throws if
  none is open.
- `await satori.subscribe(pubkey, stream_name)` → the subscription (as in
  `nostr().subscriptions`). Throws for a `_pred` stream, one no connected
  relay announces, a paid/encrypted/gated one, or over `maxStreams`. Again on
  a subscribed stream: returns it.
- `await satori.unsubscribe(pubkey, stream_name)` → `nostr()` (as `setRelays`).
- `await satori.relayPredictions(pubkey, stream_name, limit = 20)` → our
  `<stream>_pred` history for that stream, newest first: `[{ seq, value,
  model, obs_seq, made_at, event_id, relays }]` (`relays`: how many relays
  took it; 0 until they answer).
- `await satori.setRelays({ relays?: ['wss://…'], centralWrite?: boolean })`
  → `nostr()`: the user's relays (ws:// or wss://; they replace the list) and
  whether central's relays are written to.
- `await satori.base()` (also `status().base`, without the fresh read) → `{ rpc: ['/rpc'],
  rpcSetting, localFork, explorer, maxFeeSetting, maxFeeGwei, config: 'central' | 'bundled', error, errors, round, chainTime,
  identity: { address, eth, power, fee, allowedDelegator, batchesLeft, lowEth },
  vault: { address, eth, satori, delegate, delegated: 'identity' | 'none' | 'other',
  lock: { locked, indefinite, untilRound, freeAt } }, claimable: { rewards, airdrop },
  lastBatch: { round, at, hash, games: [{ streamId, gameId, named, direction, model, latest, t2 }],
  dropped: [{ …, error }] } | null, lastCheck, nextCheck, checking }`. Amounts
  are decimal strings (ETH, SATORI); `fee` is in basis points (1000 = the
  10 % default); `direction` 1 = UP, 2 = DOWN; a game's `latest` is the
  registry's last value (an `int232` in the stream's own units: the default
  stream, id 1, is the capital deployed in predictions ÷ the supply × 1e18)
  and `t2` the engine's forecast in the same units, rounded, both as decimal
  strings (they pass 2^53); `lastCheck` is the last batch check:
  `{ at, round, sent }`, `{ at, round, skipped }` or `{ at, error }`.
  `rpcSetting` and `maxFeeSetting` are what Settings stored (`''` and null:
  the defaults); `maxFeeGwei` is the ceiling in force. Before the first
  chain read (a second or two after load) `status().base` has `rpc: []`,
  `config: null` and null chain values; `satori.base()` reads at once.
- `await satori.delegate()` (needs Unlock) → `{ steps: [{ step, by: 'identity' | 'vault', hash }], settled }`.
  `steps` is empty when everything was in place.
- `await satori.undelegate()` (needs Unlock) → the same shape.
- `await satori.predictBase()` → the batch now, if due: `{ at, round, sent: { round, at, hash, games, dropped } }`
  or `{ …, skipped: 'already predicted this round' | 'no prediction power delegated to the identity' |
  'gas above the ceiling: …' | 'waiting for the batch already sent (0x…)' | … }` or `{ at, error }`.
- `await satori.claim()` (needs Unlock) → `{ rewards, merkle, airdrop }`, each
  `{ hash, amount }`, `{ skipped: why }` or `{ error }`.
- `await satori.send({ asset: 'ETH' | 'SATORI', to: '0x…', amount: '1.5' })`
  (needs Unlock) → `{ hash }`, from the vault. SATORI while transfer-locked
  throws, saying until which round.
- `await satori.setBaseRpc(url)` → `base()`: an https URL, a path on this
  site (such as `/rpc`), or `''` for the default. A saved URL replaces the
  default.
- `await satori.setBaseMaxFee(gwei)` → `base()`: the batch's ceiling on the
  max fee per gas (a positive number; `''` or null = 2 gwei). Settings saves
  both at once and checks both before saving either.

Errors are thrown as `Error` with a readable message (for example
`Wrong passphrase`, `Unlock the vault first`). Central's errors are not
thrown: they are in `status().central` (for example `central 500: …`,
`central unreachable: Failed to fetch`, `central timed out (15 s)`).

## Drive it from the UI

- Setup: "Create a new neuron" (shows the vault's 24 words, asks for three of
  them, then a passphrase), "Restore from words" (vault words, optional
  identity words), or "Import Docker files" (`wallet.yaml`, `vault.yaml`,
  optional `nostr.yaml`, the vault password). `wallet.yaml` is the unencrypted file and `vault.yaml` the
  encrypted one; files in the wrong slots, or a vault.yaml that is not
  encrypted, are refused with a message saying so.
- Home, top to bottom. **Keys**: each key with its identifiers and Copy:
  the identity (Evrmore and Base addresses), the vault (the same, its
  Locked/Unlocked badge, the "Vault passphrase" field and Unlock), the Nostr
  pubkey; the header has Lock while unlocked. **Central**: the URL,
  Registered, Last poll, Next poll, Last submission, Pending, a vault mismatch
  if any, "Poll now", and a collapsed "Streams: N from central" (one row per
  stream: latest value and time, t1, t2, the model with phi and weight in its
  hover title, Sent/Pending). **Nostr**: each relay with its state
  ("Connected · read only"), each subscribed stream (latest value and time,
  our `_pred` value, its seq, how many relays took it, Unsubscribe).
  **Network streams** (opening it discovers): a search box and the first 50
  matching streams with Subscribe/Unsubscribe. **Base**: the round, the RPC,
  the identity's ETH (as daily batches of gas; a low warning once
  delegated), the vault's SATORI and ETH, Delegation (until delegated: what
  to do), Transfers (the lock), Claimable, Last batch, Batch check, and after
  Unlock "Delegate prediction power" or "Stop delegating", "Claim", and a
  send form (asset, Amount, "To (0x address)", "Send from the vault").
  **Settings**: Central (URL, empty = default; Save), Nostr (relays one per
  line, "Publish to central's relays"; Save relays), Base (Base RPC, "Daily
  batch: max fee (gwei)"; Save Base settings). **Backup** (needs Unlock):
  Identity words, Vault words, Download wallet.yaml, vault.yaml, nostr.yaml.
- Every screen is built once and shown or hidden (the `hidden` attribute),
  so Setup's labels stay in the DOM on Home: query visible elements, or use
  `data-test`.
- Form fields have labels; elements carrying data or actions have
  `data-test` attributes: `identity`, `identity-base`, `vault`, `vault-base`,
  `vault-state`, `nostr-pubkey`, `unlock`, `lock`, `central-url`,
  `registered`, `last-poll`, `next-poll`, `last-submit`, `pending`,
  `mismatch`, `poll-now`, `streams` (the collapsed list) with `stream` rows
  and `obs`, `t1`, `t2`, `model`, `status` inside, `relay` (with
  `relay-state`), `sub` (a subscribed stream, with `sub-obs`, `sub-pred`,
  `sub-seq`, `sub-relays`, `unsubscribe`), `network`, `catalog-summary` and
  `catalog-row` (with `catalog-action`: Subscribe or Unsubscribe), on the Base
  card `base-refresh`, `base-rpc`, `base-error`, `base-identity`, `base-vault`,
  `base-delegation`, `base-lock`, `base-claimable`, `base-last-batch`,
  `base-check`, `base-delegate`, `base-undelegate`, `base-claim`,
  `base-result`, `base-txs` (the last action's transactions),
  `base-action-error`, and under Backup `wif`, `download-wallet`,
  `download-vault`, `download-nostr`.

## Base on the dev server: the local fork

The dev server's default Base RPC is `/rpc`, which it proxies to an anvil
fork of Base Sepolia on 127.0.0.1:8545 (the real D6 contracts; nothing goes
to a public chain). `node scripts/fork.mjs --help` lists:

- `start` / `stop` (anvil in the background, 2 s blocks; needs Foundry's
  anvil), every command taking `--port 8545`;
- `fund <0x…> [<0x…> …] [--eth 0.1] [--satori N]`: each address gets the ETH
  (0.1 by default) and, only with `--satori`, N SATORI from the deployer
  (~519 in all);
- `airdrop <0x…> <SATORI>`, `merkle <0x…> <SATORI>` (prints the proof a stub
  central serves), `advance [days]` (chain time; then `predictBase()`),
  `predict [up|down]` (moves the default stream), `stream [name]` (a game
  with no voting weight, which the batch leaves out).

Recipe: `fund <identity 0x…>` (gas for the batch) and
`fund <vault 0x…> --satori 100` (gas and the power to delegate), then
Unlock, `delegate()`, `predictBase()`.

## Docker neuron interop

The keys are Satori Lite's (github.com/SatoriNetwork/satori-lite and
github.com/SatoriNetwork/satorilib): one
32-byte secp256k1 secret per key = the private key = the BIP39 entropy of its
24 words. `wallet.yaml` / `vault.yaml` are read and written in Docker's format
(vault fields: AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 × 1,000,000 over the password's
Latin-1 bytes), so a neuron moves between Docker and the browser by moving the
two files (and `nostr.yaml` for the same Nostr key). Central sees the same
identity either way. The Nostr events are satorilib's byte for byte (content
serialized as Python's `json.dumps`). On Base the same secrets give the same 0x addresses as the
Docker neuron's (`ethAddress`), so delegation and rewards follow the keys.

## Code

Repository: https://github.com/lastmeta/Satori (this app is the repository
root; branch `main`). Plain JavaScript ES modules, no
build step beyond Vite, MIT licensed.

- `src/main.js`: app wiring and `window.satori`; `src/util.js`: `serial()`
  (one at a time, in order) and `isHttps()`; `src/py.js`: Python's
  `str(float)` and `json.dumps` texts, byte for byte.
- `src/keys/`: identity and vault (`index.js`), derivations and Evrmore
  signing (`keys.js`), Docker files (`docker.js`).
- `src/central/`: central's API (register, observations, login, predictions
  batch) and Python-identical payload strings.
- `src/db/`: DuckDB-WASM on OPFS, schema migrations, small async API.
- `src/engine/`: `forecast(points) → { model, t1, t2, phi?, weight? } | null`,
  pure; `forecast(points, { weight })` forces the fade, `{ step }` sets the
  bucket in seconds (12 h by default; a relay stream's cadence).
- `src/nostr/`: NIP-01 events and the Nostr key over `@noble/curves`
  (`event.js`), Satori's events and parsing (`satori.js`), one relay over a
  WebSocket with reconnect (`relay.js`).
- `src/neuron/`: register, the cycle (poll → store → forecast → submit),
  central's status, the schedule (`schedule.js`, shared with Base), the
  one-tab lock; `nostr.js`: relays, discover, subscribe, intake → `_pred`,
  reconcile; `base.js`: the daily batch and its schedule, delegate, claims,
  sends, the Base settings.
- `src/chain/`: Base over viem: `config.js` (addresses, RPC), `abi.js`,
  `index.js` (`createChain`: status multicall, delegate, the batch's pieces,
  claims, sends).
- `src/ui/`: ArrowJS screens.
- `docs/design/`: what is built and why (`OVERVIEW.md`, `keys.md`,
  `central.md` with Satori Lite's file:line references, `engine.md` with
  namaste_club's, the deviations and the backtest numbers, `nostr.md` with
  Lite's and satorilib's, `base.md` with Lite's, the dapp's and the
  contracts', `storage.md`: tables, migrations, meta keys); `docs/plans/`:
  the roadmap and what is left of each part; `docs/issues/`: open issues
  outside this repo; `docs/inbox/QUESTIONS.md`: open questions for the
  owner.
- `scripts/`: parity-vector generators run against satorilib, the Docker
  image and namaste_club (Python); `backtest.mjs` (node, read only);
  `test-relay.mjs` (an in-memory Nostr relay: `node scripts/test-relay.mjs
  7778`) and `provider.mjs` (a throwaway stream provider for a test relay);
  `fork.mjs` (the local fork of Base Sepolia, above).
- `test/`: fixtures (parity vectors) and test doubles (a fake D6 behind
  JSON-RPC, an in-memory DuckDB); `e2e/`: Playwright specs and their stub
  central (`stub.js`).
- Tests: `npm test` (vitest), `npm run e2e` (Playwright, Chrome, a stub
  central, two test relays, a fake chain behind `/rpc`).

## Contribute

Pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/lastmeta/Satori. Keep changes
small, tested (vitest / Playwright) and in plain JS; follow the patterns of the
Docker neuron (Satori Lite) and satorilib; update `docs/design/` and this file
with what you change.
